rationale: The plan fits a single ~condition model on all twelve samples, answers the omnibus question with the DESeq2 LRT against ~1 and the pairwise question with named treated_a/treated_b vs control contrasts, and correctly notes that a Wald refit is required so LRT p-values are never reported beside a pairwise fold change. QC (blind VST PCA, distance heatmap, library sizes, explicit no-drop outlier policy), the 10-counts-in-4-samples filter, in-model median-of-ratios normalization, explicit relevel to control, ashr shrinkage for multi-level contrasts, and BH at 0.05 within each contrast are all stated and justified for this design. The report step names method, versions, design, thresholds, tested/DE counts, and the two honest caveats (missing length offset, n=4 power). Enrichment was not requested; the plan adds it as secondary context but specifies it properly (full Wald-ranked list, named collections with releases, 15-500 window, universe, seed), so it loses only a little for scope beyond the question.
